title: Test Mock `OracleMock.setPrice` and `ERC20Mock.setBalance` Are Unprotected — Unsafe if Ever Deployed Beyond Test Context
severity: Medium (test-only; zero risk if confined to test fixtures)
impact: `OracleMock.setPrice(uint256)` and `ERC20Mock.setBalance(address,uint256)` have no access control and can be called by anyone. If any deployment pipeline ever deploys these mocks to a live network (e.g., for a testnet demo or by mistake), anyone can arbitrarily reprice collateral or mint/drain token balances, trivially liquidating any position or breaking any integration using these tokens/oracles.
